st.viv.chicago_no_speech_prepared.l: You can belong fully to your own tradition and still honour every other path.
st.viv.chicago_no_speech_prepared.s: An unknown 30-year-old monk from India, with no invitation and little money, rises on the Parliament's opening day and greets the hall as 'Sisters and Brothers of America'. The audience stands and applauds for minutes. In a five-minute address he says India's faith accepts all religions as true and hopes the day marks the death-knell of fanaticism.
st.viv.chicago_no_speech_prepared.t: 'Sisters and Brothers of America': Chicago, 11 September 1893

st.viv.frog_in_the_well.l: Before you judge another faith or culture, check the size of your own well.
st.viv.frog_in_the_well.s: Asked why religions quarrel, he tells of a frog who has lived all its life in a well. When a frog from the sea arrives and describes the ocean, the well-frog refuses to believe anything can be bigger than his well and drives the visitor out. Each of us, he says, sits in a little well and calls it the world.
st.viv.frog_in_the_well.t: The frog in the well (Chicago, 15 September 1893)

st.viv.ghost_that_must_be_kept_busy.l: Helping is a privilege, not a debt someone owes you.
st.viv.ghost_that_must_be_kept_busy.s: The world does not need our help; helping is a privilege that makes us stronger. Expecting thanks brings unhappiness, so be grateful to the one you help. The world is a moral gymnasium, and calm people do the best work.
st.viv.ghost_that_must_be_kept_busy.t: Karma-Yoga 5: we help ourselves, not the world

st.viv.sage_who_would_not_teach.l: No honest work is beneath you; doing it well is the practice.
st.viv.sage_who_would_not_teach.s: A young ascetic who can burn a bird with a glance is humbled by a housewife who knows what he did, and she sends him to a butcher in the market for teaching. The butcher, doing his trade honestly and caring for his parents, teaches him the highest truth. Doing the duty in front of you, without attachment, is itself the path.
st.viv.sage_who_would_not_teach.t: The proud ascetic, the housewife and the butcher

roles: Shows rest in your own kind of fruit.
viv.1.apple_standard.sa: To judge the apple tree you must take the apple standard, and for the oak, its own standard.

roles: Take in the best of the other.
viv.1.assimilate_grow.sa: each must assimilate the spirit of the others and yet preserve his individuality

viv.1.blows_inner_fire.sa: it was blows that brought out their inner fire more than praise.

viv.1.come_up_lions.sa: Come up, O lions, and shake off the delusion that you are sheep;

roles: Gives help without the idea that it all hangs on me.
viv.1.dependent_on_me.sa: It is a weakness to think that any one is dependent on me,

viv.1.dont_think_result.sa: If you want to do a great or a good work, do not trouble to think what the result will be.

viv.1.duty_disease.sa: Be at rest, be free, and work.

roles: Shows strength gathered one duty at a time.
viv.1.duty_next_to_us.sa: The only way to rise is by doing the duty next to us,

roles: Shows love is what turns a chore.
viv.1.duty_sweet_love.sa: Duty is sweet only through love, and love shines in freedom alone.

roles: Shows the work itself as the goal for now.
viv.1.end_and_means.sa: "Let the end and the means be joined into one."

roles: Shows the world going on without us.
viv.1.five_minutes.sa: we all die, and in five minutes the world forgets us.

roles: Shows forbearance chosen as an act of freedom.
viv.1.forbear.sa: In all these little roughnesses that we meet with in life, the highest expression of freedom is to forbear.

roles: Shows the other is only in another well.
viv.1.frog_in_well.sa: I am sitting in my own little well and thinking that the whole world is my little well.

viv.1.good_impressions.sa: if a man thinks good thoughts and does good works, the sum total of these impressions will be good;

roles: Shows thanking the chance to serve.
viv.1.grateful_to_helped.sa: Be grateful to the man you help, think of him as God.

roles: Shows help and harmony as the rule between different people.
viv.1.help_not_fight.sa: "Help and not Fight," "Assimilation and not Destruction," "Harmony and Peace and not Dissension."

viv.1.inside_the_machine.sa: Do not fly away from the wheels of the world-machine, but stand inside it and learn the secret of work.

roles: Names character built in small daily acts.
viv.1.judge_character.sa: Watch a man do his most common actions; those are indeed the things which will tell you the real character of a great man.

roles: Shows asking which part of the feeling is clinging.
viv.1.love_no_pain.sa: love only brings a reaction of bliss; if it does not, it is not love;

viv.1.make_ourselves.sa: We are responsible for what we are; and whatever we wish ourselves to be, we have the power to make ourselves.

viv.1.master_not_slave.sa: you should work like a master and not as a slave;

viv.1.misery_attachment.sa: "Misery comes through attachment, not through work."

roles: Shows the teacher saying how hard it is to control the mind.
viv.1.monkey_mind.sa: The human mind is like that monkey, incessantly active by its own nature;

viv.1.moral_gymnasium.sa: The world is a grand moral gymnasium wherein we have all to take exercise so as to become stronger and stronger spiritually.

roles: Names dignity in whatever work is one's own.
viv.1.no_duty_ugly.sa: no duty is ugly, no duty is impure.

roles: Trust in oneself is made the first step to trust in God.
viv.1.not_hate_ourselves.sa: Our first duty is not to hate ourselves, because to advance we must have faith in ourselves first and then in God.

roles: Shows the stance of a giver.
viv.1.position_of_giver.sa: Attachment comes only where we expect a return.

roles: The divine is within, to be brought out.
viv.1.potentially_divine.sa: Doctrines, or dogmas, or rituals, or books, or temples, or forms, are but secondary details.

viv.1.silence_in_activity.sa: in the midst of the intensest activity finds the silence and solitude of the desert.

viv.1.sneers_ridicule.sa: A man must go about his duties without taking notice of the sneers and the ridicule of the world.

roles: Shows the world is not fixed as hostile.
viv.1.state_of_mind.sa: Life is good or evil according to the state of mind in which we look at it, it is neither by itself.

viv.1.streams_to_sea.sa: the different paths which men take through different tendencies, various though they appear, crooked or straight, all lead to Thee.

viv.1.suppress_anger.sa: Each time we suppress hatred, or a feeling of anger, it is so much good energy stored up in our favour;

viv.1.take_up_one_idea.sa: Take up one idea. Make that one idea your life — think of it, dream of it, live on that idea.

viv.1.through_their_eyes.sa: see the duty of others through their own eyes, and never judge the customs of other peoples by our own standard.

roles: Names acceptance going beyond putting up with others.
viv.1.tolerance_acceptance.sa: We believe not only in universal toleration, but we accept all religions as true.

roles: Shows have faith in yourselves cultivates faith.
viv.1.true_to_nature.sa: The greatest religion is to be true to your own nature. Have faith in yourselves!

roles: Shows others at their own truth.
viv.1.truth_to_truth.sa: man is not travelling from error to truth, but from truth to truth,

roles: Shows work that needs no witness.
viv.1.unknown_heroes.sa: Seek no praise, no reward, for anything you do.

viv.1.wait_and_watch.sa: Let the monkey jump as much as he can; you simply wait and watch.

viv.1.weakness_as_forgiveness.sa: Many a time comes when we want to interpret our weakness and cowardice as forgiveness

roles: Gives help without a claim on gratitude.
viv.1.without_approbation.sa: for a man to constantly do good without caring for the approbation of his fellow men is indeed the highest sacrifice man can perform.

roles: Names the stance of the witness.
viv.1.witness.sa: do not mix in the fray, hold yourself as a witness and go on working.

viv.2.angels_unawares.sa: We shall make mistakes, but they may be angels unawares.

viv.2.atheist_himself.sa: The new religion says that he is the atheist who does not believe in himself.

roles: Shows the forgiving mind as the effective one.
viv.2.calm_mind_works.sa: It is the calm, forgiving, equable, well-balanced mind that does the greatest amount of work.

viv.2.cannot_give_up.sa: perhaps it is a failure and yet we cannot give it up.

roles: Trusts in the child's own growth.
viv.2.child_teaches_himself.sa: Your duty is to afford opportunities and to remove obstacles.

roles: Gives help where help is possible.
viv.2.condemn_none.sa: Condemn none; if you can stretch out a helping hand, do so.

roles: Shows one's future as one's own making.
viv.2.creator_of_destiny.sa: know that you are the creator of your own destiny.

viv.2.difference_sign_of_thought.sa: Thinking beings must differ; difference is the first sign of thought.

roles: Shows standing by with folded hands.
viv.2.do_not_destroy.sa: Say not a word against any man's convictions so far as they are sincere.

roles: Shows sympathy from memory of one's own stumbling.
viv.2.eyes_of_love.sa: we should see others with eyes of love, with sympathy, knowing that they are going along the same path that we have trodden.

roles: Shows one is living wherever life lives.
viv.2.fear_of_death.sa: Those moments alone we live when our lives are in the universe, in others;

viv.2.grow_from_inside.sa: You have to teach yourself; your growth must come from inside.

roles: Shows light which was from the beginning.
viv.2.hands_before_eyes.sa: It is we who have put our hands before our eyes and cry that it is dark.

viv.2.help_from_within.sa: All the help that has come was from within yourselves.

roles: Shows each way honoured as true so far.
viv.2.hundred_thousand_ways.sa: truth may be expressed in a hundred thousand ways, and that each of these ways is true as far as it goes.

roles: Names a form of faith that fits you.
viv.2.language_of_soul.sa: They must speak your own language, the language of your soul,

viv.2.little_mental_universe.sa: we are always inclined to think that our little mental universe is all that is;

viv.2.love_in_return.sa: not from the fact that we love, but from the fact that we want love in return.

viv.2.means_and_end.sa: pay as much attention to the means of work as to its end.

viv.2.mistakes_made_me.sa: without every one of those mistakes I should not be what I am today,

roles: Shows holding the ideal a thousand times.
viv.2.never_mind_failures.sa: hold the ideal a thousand times, and if you fail a thousand times, make the attempt once more.

viv.2.nothing_is_lost.r: Complete Works, Vol. 2, Hints On Practical Spirituality, p. 36
viv.2.nothing_is_lost.sa: But though it is so hard to reach the goal, yet even our smallest attempts are not in vain. We know that nothing is lost.

viv.2.razor_edge.sa: the way is long and perilous, but struggle on, do not despair.

viv.2.reason_not_authority.sa: it is better that mankind should become atheist by following reason

roles: Shows turning the mind to what is strong in you.
viv.2.remedy_weakness.sa: The remedy for weakness is not brooding over weakness, but thinking of strength.

viv.2.still_small_voice.r: Complete Works, Vol. 2, Jnana-Yoga: Maya And Freedom, p. 123
roles: Shows a voice leading us forward.
viv.2.still_small_voice.sa: in the midst of sorrow and suffering, even in this world where life and death are synonymous, even here, there is a still small voice

roles: Gives the ability to stay able to love.
viv.2.stony_heart.sa: the man who never loves, who is hard and stony, escaping most of the miseries of life, escapes also its joys.

viv.2.strength_is_life.sa: This is the great fact: strength is life, weakness is death.

viv.2.strike_a_match.sa: Strike a match and light comes in a moment.

roles: Cultivates freedom comes with this seeing.
viv.2.temple_of_man.sa: the moment I stand in reverence before every human being and see God in him

roles: Shows the strength rests on what the soul is.
viv.3.arise_awake.sa: Arise, awake, and stop not till the goal is reached.

viv.3.be_not_afraid.sa: it is fearlessness that brings heaven even in a moment.

viv.3.dare_to_be_free.sa: dare to be free, dare to go as far as your thought leads, and dare to carry that out in your life.

roles: Depicts the hurt of friends whose warmth ended when he disagreed.
viv.3.dares_to_differ.sa: as soon as he dares to differ, that sympathy is gone, that love vanishes.

viv.3.do_not_become_others.sa: Learn everything that is good from others, but bring it in, and in your own way absorb it; do not become others.

roles: Shows a returning traveller giving thanks for kindness abroad.
viv.3.hospitality_west.sa: how wonderfully and how hospitably I was received in every country in the West.

viv.3.make_children_strong.sa: Make your children strong from their very childhood;

roles: Shows the sick and weak where worship happens.
viv.3.real_worship.sa: This is the gist of all worship — to be pure and to do good to others.

viv.3.realised_not_heard.sa: Religion is to be realised, not only heard; it is not in learning some doctrine like a parrot.

roles: Cultivates keeping the hunger to learn.
viv.3.refuses_to_learn.sa: that man who refuses to learn is already dead.

viv.3.reject_as_poison.sa: anything that makes you weak physically, intellectually, and spiritually, reject as poison;

viv.3.seed_becomes_tree.sa: It becomes the mighty plant, the mighty tree, after its own nature, having absorbed everything that was given to it.

viv.3.servant_first.sa: Always first learn to be a servant, and then you will be fit to be a master.

viv.3.whatever_you_think.sa: If you think yourselves weak, weak you will be; if you think yourselves strong, strong you will be;

viv.3.where_we_agree.sa: Let us preach where we all agree and leave the differences to remedy themselves.

viv.4.agony_at_the_heart.r: Complete Works, Vol. 4, Writings: Prose: A Message Of Sympathy To A Friend, p. 355
roles: Shows the heart fighting the faith it holds.
viv.4.agony_at_the_heart.sa: There is, Father of Love, an agony at the heart which is fighting against that calm resignation which Thou teachest

roles: Shows rest like the rest in music.
viv.4.calm_of_heart.sa: The silence between speaking; Between two fits of passion — It is the calm of heart.

viv.4.circle_of_light.r: Complete Works, Vol. 4, Lectures and Discourses: Christ, The Messenger, p. 153
roles: Shows the golden thread to the divine.
viv.4.circle_of_light.sa: there is always somewhere in our heart of hearts, however low and degraded we may be, a little circle of light

roles: Shows the deep stratum is what one is.
viv.4.deep_down_calm.sa: deep down there is the stratum of infinite calmness, infinite peace, and infinite bliss.

roles: Perfection and divinity are shown as already within.
viv.4.education_religion.sa: Education is the manifestation of the perfection already in man.

roles: Shows the heart grows in giving.
viv.4.hearts_purified.sa: The more we come out and do good to others, the more our hearts will be purified, and God will be in them.

viv.4.hold_on_brave_heart.sa: Still hold on yet a while, brave heart, The victory is sure to come.

roles: Names the others as the poor he wanted educated.
viv.4.live_for_others.sa: they alone live who live for others, the rest are more dead than alive.

viv.4.love_pays.sa: It is love that pays; it is character that cleaves its way

viv.4.no_winter.sa: No winter was but summer came behind,

roles: Shows praiser and blamer are one.
viv.4.praise_blame_one.sa: No praise or blame can be Where praiser praised, and blamer blamed are one.

roles: Thy service true, complete thy sacrifice.
viv.4.requiescat.sa: Remembrance sweet, that kills all space and time, Like altar roses fill thy place behind!

viv.4.servant_while_leading.sa: Be the servant while leading. Be unselfish, and never listen to one friend in private accusing another. Have infinite patience, and success is yours.

roles: The same effort in dark and light.
viv.4.struggle_motto.sa: When it was all dark, I used to say, struggle; when light is breaking in, I still say, struggle.

viv.5.bob_up_soon.r: Complete Works, Vol. 5, Epistles, First Series, CIII, p. 160
roles: Shows waiting for the next turn.
viv.5.bob_up_soon.sa: Yet I am sure to bob up soon and am waiting for the next turn.

roles: Shows conviction giving birth to the deed.
viv.5.great_convictions.sa: Have faith in yourselves, great convictions are the mothers of great deeds.

viv.5.hero_in_silence.sa: cowards assume the attitude of the brave when everything is sure to turn out well, but the true hero works in silence.

viv.5.not_in_a_day.sa: Do not expect success in a day or a year.

roles: Shows keeping going through the stages.
viv.5.ridicule_opposition.sa: Each work has to pass through these stages — ridicule, opposition, and then acceptance.

roles: Names the one life from lowest form to man.
viv.5.same_unity.sa: We may call it God, Allah, Jehovah, the Spirit, Love;

viv.5.soul_is_a_star.r: Complete Works, Vol. 5, Epistles, First Series, XXXI, p. 70
roles: Names real individuality as in the infinite.
viv.5.soul_is_a_star.sa: Each soul is a star, and all stars are set in that infinite azure, that eternal sky, the Lord.

viv.6.behind_my_work.sa: Behind my work was ambition, behind my love was personality,

viv.6.essence_of_education.sa: To me the very essence of education is concentration of mind, not the collecting of facts.

roles: Cultivates acting without the nervous dread.
viv.6.fearful_to_hurt.sa: by being so fearful to hurt we hurt more.

roles: Holds suffering and blunders alongside birth and peace.
viv.6.glad_blunders.sa: I am glad I was born, glad I suffered so, glad I did make big blunders, glad to enter peace.

viv.6.nothing_lasts.sa: Never mind, nothing is to last for ever.

viv.6.one_thing_at_a_time.sa: Do one thing at a time and while doing it put your whole soul into it to the exclusion of all else.

roles: Gives the power to withdraw the mind at will.
viv.6.power_of_detachment.sa: Almost all our suffering is caused by our not having the power of detachment.

roles: Shows failure not canceling the striving.
viv.6.strive_to_be_great.sa: Even if he fails in life, still I will have the satisfaction that he strove to become great

viv.6.the_cup.sa: it is not meant for any other hand,
viv.6.the_cup.sp: Swami Vivekananda (the poem speaks in the Divine's voice)

viv.6.three_essentials.sa: Purity, patience, and perseverance are the three essentials to success and, above all, love.

viv.6.tropics_or_poles.r: Complete Works, Vol. 6, Epistles, Second Series, LXII, p. 304
roles: Shows my refuge, my friend, my real Self.
viv.6.tropics_or_poles.sa: Thou wilt be with me in the tropics or at the poles, on the tops of mountains or in the depth of oceans.

viv.6.weary_take_my_hand.r: Complete Works, Vol. 6, Notes of Class Talks and Lectures: On Bhakti-Yoga, p. 91
viv.6.weary_take_my_hand.sa: Lord! I have become weary. Oh, take me by the hand, Lord, I take shelter with Thee

viv.7.i_am_near.r: Complete Works, Vol. 7, Epistles, Third Series, IX, p. 452
viv.7.i_am_near.sa: Meseems I hear Thee whispering sweet My love, "I am near", "I am near". My heart gets strong.

viv.7.neither_seek_nor_avoid.sa: Neither seek nor avoid, take what comes.

viv.7.round_us_this_minute.r: Complete Works, Vol. 7, Epistles, Third Series, XXXV, p. 500
roles: The spirit is immortal and everywhere.
viv.7.round_us_this_minute.sa: All that we ever had are round us this minute, for the spirit can neither come nor go, it only changes its plane of manifestation.

roles: Shows the mind watching what it thinks.
viv.7.thoughts_live.sa: We are what our thoughts have made us; so take care of what you think.

viv.7.want_a_bit_of_peace.r: Complete Works, Vol. 7, Epistles, Third Series, LII, p. 525
viv.7.want_a_bit_of_peace.sa: I just want a bit of peace badly — pray for me.

viv.8.all_right_long_run.r: Complete Works, Vol. 8, Lectures and Discourses: Is Vedanta The Future Religion?, p. 127
viv.8.all_right_long_run.sa: There are mistakes but no sin; and in the long run everything is going to be all right.

viv.8.come_good_come_evil.sa: Be brave and face everything — come good, come evil, both welcome,

viv.8.comfort_no_test.sa: "Comfort" is no test of truth; on the contrary, truth is often far from being "comfortable"

viv.8.early_violet.sa: Change not thy nature, gentle bloom, Thou violet, sweet and pure, But ever pour thy sweet perfume Unasked, unstinted, sure!

viv.8.exchange_grief.r: Complete Works, Vol. 8, Epistles, Fourth Series, CLVI, p. 493
roles: Shows the wish to take another's pain.
viv.8.exchange_grief.sa: if it were possible to exchange grief, and had I a cheerful mind, I would exchange mine for your grief ever and always.

viv.8.faith_totters.r: Complete Works, Vol. 8, Epistles, Fourth Series, XXIII, p. 316
roles: Shows faith that wavers despite everything.
viv.8.faith_totters.sa: What a rogue am I that in the face of such mercies sometimes the faith totters — seeing every moment that I am in His hands.

viv.8.heart_lives_on.r: Complete Works, Vol. 8, Epistles, Fourth Series, CLVI, p. 492
roles: Depicts a monk admitting his own sorrow at a friend's death.
viv.8.heart_lives_on.sa: I am sorry, because in spite of monastic training, the heart lives on;

roles: Names belief in yourself as the first step.
viv.8.lotus_bees.sa: Bring your own lotus to blossom: the bees will come of themselves.

viv.8.mental_hell_lifted.r: Complete Works, Vol. 8, Epistles, Fourth Series, CLVII, p. 494
roles: Shows never a moment's peaceful life always high pressure.
viv.8.mental_hell_lifted.sa: I have been living in mental hell. It is partially lifted now, and I hope for better days, better states.

viv.8.never_never_never.r: Complete Works, Vol. 8, Epistles, Fourth Series, XXIII, p. 316
roles: Take refuge in Him like a child.
viv.8.never_never_never.sa: Sister, there is a God — a Father — a Mother who never leaves His Children, never, never, never.

viv.8.not_good_enough.r: Complete Works, Vol. 8, Epistles, Fourth Series, CLVI, p. 492
roles: 'I was not good enough to that person'
viv.8.not_good_enough.sa: the most curious cause of suffering when somebody goes off is the feeling that I was not good enough to that person.

viv.8.smiles_and_tears.r: Complete Works, Vol. 8, Epistles, Fourth Series, CLVI, p. 493
roles: Shows we see it is so and that is enough.
viv.8.smiles_and_tears.sa: We learn, through smiles and tears we learn. We don't know why, but we see it is so; and that is enough.

viv.8.soul_of_light.r: Complete Works, Vol. 8, Writings: Poems: Light, p. 168
viv.8.soul_of_light.sa: I look behind and after And find that all is right, In my deepest sorrows There is a soul of light.

viv.8.take_things_easy.r: Complete Works, Vol. 8, Epistles, Fourth Series, CXXIV, p. 448
roles: Shows a few strong strokes, then rest on your oars.
viv.8.take_things_easy.sa: The Lord is watching over us; there is no fear; do not lose your nerves, keep your health and take things easy.
